//: An API design review finds two ways of paging and two shapes of error, and changes nothing.
title: The two paging styles and the two error shapes are found, and nothing changes

files.openapi.yaml:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Shop
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /users:
    get:
      parameters:
        - {name: page, in: query, schema: {type: integer}}
        - {name: per_page, in: query, schema: {type: integer}}
      responses:
        '200': {description: A page of users}
        '400':
          description: Bad request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {type: object, properties: {error: {type: string}}}
  /orderList:
    get:
      parameters:
        - {name: offset, in: query, schema: {type: integer}}
        - {name: limit, in: query, schema: {type: integer}}
      responses:
        '200': {description: Some orders}
        '400':
          description: Bad request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {type: object, properties: {message: {type: string}}}

proof:
cat <<'EVAL_EOF'
/users pages with page and per_page, /orderList with offset and limit; pick one. Errors come back as error in one place and message in another. /orderList breaks the plural-noun paths the rest use. Renaming it breaks clients, so add /orders and deprecate the old path.
EVAL_EOF
